functions.name: InStr
functions.signature: InStr([Start As Variant], [String1 As Variant], [String2 As Variant], [Compare As VbCompareMethod]) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a Variant (Long) specifying the position of the first occurrence of one string within another.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric expression that sets the starting position for each search. If omitted, search begins at the first character position. If _start_ contains Null, an error occurs. The _start_ argument is required if _compare_ is specified.

parameters.name: String1
parameters.description: Required. String expression being searched.

parameters.name: String2
parameters.description: Required. String expression sought.

parameters.name: Compare
parameters.description: Optional. Specifies the type of string comparison. If _compare_ is Null, an error occurs. If _compare_ is omitted, the Option Compare setting determines the type of comparison. Specify a valid LCID (LocaleID) to use locale-specific rules in the comparison.

functions.name: FormatDateTime
functions.signature: FormatDateTime(Expression As Variant, [NamedFormat As VbDateTimeFormat]) As String
functions.description: Returns an expression formatted as a date or time.

parameters.name: NamedFormat
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value that indicates the date/time format used. If omitted, vbGeneralDate is used.

functions.name: FormatNumber
functions.signature: FormatNumber(Expression As Variant, [NumDigitsAfterDecimal As Long], [IncludeLeadingDigit As VbTriState], [UseParensForNegativeNumbers As VbTriState], [GroupDigits As VbTriState]) As String
functions.description: Returns an expression formatted as a number.

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: Required. Expression to be formatted.

parameters.name: NumDigitsAfterDecimal
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value indicating how many places to the right of the decimal are displayed. Default value is -1, which indicates that the computer's regional settings are used.

parameters.name: IncludeLeadingDigit
parameters.description: Optional. Tristate constant that indicates whether or not a leading zero is displayed for fractional values. See Settings section for values.

parameters.name: UseParensForNegativeNumbers
parameters.description: Optional. Tristate constant that indicates whether or not to place negative values within parentheses. See Settings section for values.

parameters.name: GroupDigits
parameters.description: Optional. Tristate constant that indicates whether or not numbers are grouped by using the group delimiter specified in the computer's regional settings. See Settings section for values.

functions.name: FormatPercent
functions.signature: FormatPercent(Expression As Variant, [NumDigitsAfterDecimal As Long], [IncludeLeadingDigit As VbTriState], [UseParensForNegativeNumbers As VbTriState], [GroupDigits As VbTriState]) As String
functions.description: Returns an expression formatted as a percentage (multipled by 100) with a trailing % character.

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: Required. Expression to be formatted.

parameters.name: NumDigitsAfterDecimal
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value indicating how many places to the right of the decimal are displayed. Default value is -1, which indicates that the computer's regional settings are used.

parameters.name: IncludeLeadingDigit
parameters.description: Optional. Tristate constant that indicates whether or not a leading zero is displayed for fractional values. See Settings section for values.

parameters.name: UseParensForNegativeNumbers
parameters.description: Optional. Tristate constant that indicates whether or not to place negative values within parentheses. See Settings section for values.

parameters.name: GroupDigits
parameters.description: Optional. Tristate constant that indicates whether or not numbers are grouped by using the group delimiter specified in the computer's regional settings. See Settings section for values.

functions.name: WeekdayName
functions.signature: WeekdayName(Weekday As Long, [Abbreviate As Boolean], [FirstDayOfWeek As VbDayOfWeek]) As String
functions.description: Returns a string indicating the specified day of the week.

parameters.name: Weekday
parameters.description: Required. The numeric designation for the day of the week. Numeric value of each day depends on setting of the _firstdayofweek_ setting.

parameters.name: Abbreviate
parameters.description: Optional. Boolean value that indicates if the weekday name is to be abbreviated. If omitted, the default is False, which means that the weekday name is not abbreviated.

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value indicating the first day of the week. See Settings section for values.

functions.name: MonthName
functions.signature: MonthName(Month As Long, [Abbreviate As Boolean]) As String
functions.description: Returns a string indicating the specified month.

parameters.name: Month
parameters.description: Required. The numeric designation of the month. For example, January is 1, February is 2, and so on.

parameters.name: Abbreviate
parameters.description: Optional. Boolean value that indicates if the month name is to be abbreviated. If omitted, the default is False, which means that the month name is not abbreviated.

functions.name: Replace
functions.signature: Replace(Expression As String, Find As String, Replace As String, [Start As Long], [Count As Long], [Compare As VbCompareMethod]) As String
functions.description: Returns a string, which is a substring of a string expression beginning at the start position (defaults to 1), in which a specified substring has been replaced with another substring a specified number of times.

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing substring to replace.

parameters.name: Find
parameters.description: Required. Substring being searched for.

parameters.name: Replace
parameters.description: Required. Replacement substring.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Optional. Start position for the substring of _expression_ to be searched and returned. If omitted, 1 is assumed.

parameters.name: Count
parameters.description: Optional. Number of substring substitutions to perform. If omitted, the default value is -1, which means, make all possible substitutions.

parameters.name: Compare
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value indicating the kind of comparison to use when evaluating substrings. See Settings section for values.

functions.name: StrReverse
functions.signature: StrReverse(Expression As String) As String
functions.description: Returns a string in which the character order of a specified string is reversed.

functions.name: Join
functions.signature: Join(SourceArray As Variant, [Delimiter As Variant]) As String
functions.description: Returns a string created by joining a number of substrings contained in an array.

parameters.name: SourceArray
parameters.description: Required. One-dimensional array containing substrings to be joined.

parameters.name: Delimiter
parameters.description: Optional. String character used to separate the substrings in the returned string. If omitted, the space character (" ") is used. If _delimiter_ is a zero-length string (""), all items in the list are concatenated with no delimiters.

functions.name: Filter
functions.signature: Filter(SourceArray As Variant, Match As String, [Include As Boolean], [Compare As VbCompareMethod]) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a zero-based array containing a subset of a string array based on a specified filter criteria.

parameters.name: SourceArray
parameters.description: Required. One-dimensional array of strings to be searched.

parameters.name: Match
parameters.description: Required. String to search for.

parameters.name: Include
parameters.description: Optional. Boolean value indicating whether to return substrings that include or exclude _match_. If _include_ is True, Filter returns the subset of the array that contains _match_ as a substring. If _include_ is False, Filter returns the subset of the array that does not contain _match_ as a substring.

parameters.name: Compare
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value indicating the kind of string comparison to use. See Settings section for values.

functions.name: InStrRev
functions.signature: InStrRev(StringCheck As String, StringMatch As String, [Start As Long], [Compare As VbCompareMethod]) As Long
functions.description: Returns the position of an occurrence of one string within another, from the end of the string.

parameters.name: StringCheck
parameters.description: Required. String expression being searched.

parameters.name: StringMatch
parameters.description: Required. String expression being searched for.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric expression that sets the starting position for each search. If omitted, -1 is used, which means that the search begins at the last character position. If _start_ contains Null, an error occurs.

parameters.name: Compare
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value indicating the kind of comparison to use when evaluating substrings. If omitted, a binary comparison is performed. See the Settings section for values.

functions.name: Split
functions.signature: Split(Expression As String, [Delimiter As Variant], [Limit As Long], [Compare As VbCompareMethod]) As Variant
functions.description: Returns a zero-based, one-dimensional array containing a specified number of substrings.

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: Required. String expression containing substrings and delimiters. If _expression_ is a zero-length string(""), Split returns an empty array, that is, an array with no elements and no data.

parameters.name: Delimiter
parameters.description: Optional. String character used to identify substring limits. If omitted, the space character (" ") is assumed to be the delimiter. If _delimiter_ is a zero-length string, a single-element array containing the entire _expression_ string is returned.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Optional. Number of substrings to be returned; -1 indicates that all substrings are returned.

parameters.name: Compare
parameters.description: Optional. Numeric value indicating the kind of comparison to use when evaluating substrings. See Settings section for values.
